newsitem.title: FRANCE: TV5 in France plans Americas programmes in 1997.
newsitem.headline: TV5 in France plans Americas programmes in 1997.

text.p: TV5, the pan-European French-language television channel, said it planned to launch TV5 America this year, with programmes for the United States and Latin America.

"We already broadcast programmes for Latin America from Montreal and two hours a day to the United States on International Channel. Broadcasts to the two zones via common programmes will be operational by the end of the year," a spokesman said.
Le Monde newspaper said earlier that the special programme offering would be in place by March. It also said TV5 would soon appoint a development director in the United States.
TV5 is owned by various French state broadcasting organisations.
